title: Matt Judon, three others work out for 49ers with Nick Bosa injured

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matt Judon, three others work out for 49ers with Nick Bosa injured
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa is out for Sunday's game with a calf injury and he is expected to miss more time, so the team looked at a few options to bolster the position on Saturday.
